blocks.text: The digital divide has far-reaching effects: it can deepen existing inequalities and create new ones in education, the economy, civic life, health and digital literacy.

blocks.prompt: Why can the digital divide make existing inequality worse?
blocks.explanation: Those already disadvantaged lose access to online learning, jobs and services, so they fall further behind those who have access.

items: Impacts: education, economy, civic participation, health, digital literacy.
